title: WabbleSpec Recipe
description: Schema for recipe.json produced by the Recipe module (L0). Declares build target, platform, complexity, and session configuration.

target.description: Declared build target (e.g. Framework, Web, CLI, API/Service).

detection_method.description: How the target was detected (explicit-instruction, file-pattern, dependency-scan).

secondary_targets.description: Additional detected targets beyond the primary.

collapse_eligible.description: Whether this session is eligible for phase collapse.

active_skills.description: Subset of skills loaded for this session (empty = all skills).

locked_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when recipe was locked.
